parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces gigabit-ethernet1/0/0 uni.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces gigabit-ethernet1/0/0 uni.command: set interfaces gigabit-ethernet1/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:DB8::1/64
set interfaces gigabit-ethernet1/0/0 uni.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set interfaces gigabit-ethernet2/0/0 uni.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet6 address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces gigabit-ethernet2/0/0 uni.command: set interfaces gigabit-ethernet2/0/0 unit 0 family inet6 address 2001:DB8:1::1/64
set interfaces gigabit-ethernet2/0/0 uni.explanation: 配置接口的IPv6地址及前缀长度。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 addr.template: set failover group1 ipv6 standbys [parameter1] address [parameter2]
set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 addr.command: set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 address FE80::1
set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 addr.explanation: 配置故障转移组的IPv6备用地址。

set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 addr.template: set failover group1 ipv6 standbys [parameter1] address [parameter2]
set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 addr.command: set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 address 2001:DB8::100
set failover group1 ipv6 standbys 1 addr.explanation: 配置故障转移组的IPv6备用地址。

set failover group1 priority 120.explanation: 配置故障转移组的优先级。

parameters.name: priority
parameters.explanation: 故障转移组的优先级，数值越小优先级越高。

set failover group1 preempt-delay minimu.explanation: 配置故障转移组的最小抢占延迟时间。

parameters.name: minimum-delay
parameters.explanation: 最小抢占延迟时间，单位为秒。

set failover group1 track gigabit-ethern.command: set failover group1 track gigabit-ethernet2/0/0 priority 40

set failover group1 protocol ospf priori.command: set failover group1 protocol ospf priority 2
set failover group1 protocol ospf priori.explanation: 配置故障转移组协议的优先级。

set failover group1 bfd neighbor 2001:DB.template: set failover group1 bfd neighbor [parameter1] interface [parameter2]
set failover group1 bfd neighbor 2001:DB.command: set failover group1 bfd neighbor 2001:DB8::2 interface gigabit-ethernet1/0/0
set failover group1 bfd neighbor 2001:DB.explanation: 配置故障转移组的BFD邻居及其接口。

parameters.name: interface
parameters.explanation: 与BFD邻居相连的接口名称。

set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 int.template: set protocols ospf v3 [parameter1] area [parameter2] interface [parameter3]
set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 int.command: set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 interface gigabit-ethernet1/0/0
set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 int.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议的区域及接口。

set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 int.template: set protocols ospf v3 [parameter1] area [parameter2] interface [parameter3]
set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 int.command: set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 interface gigabit-ethernet2/0/0
set protocols ospf v3 1 area 0.0.0.0 int.explanation: 配置OSPFv3协议的区域及接口。

set forwarding-options forwarder bfd-tem.template: set forwarding-options forwarder bfd-template single-hop [parameter1] interval min-tx [parameter2] min-rx [parameter3] multiplier [parameter4]
set forwarding-options forwarder bfd-tem.command: set forwarding-options forwarder bfd-template single-hop AToB interval min-tx 50 min-rx 50 multiplier 3

parameters.name: min-tx-interval
parameters.explanation: 最小发送间隔，单位为毫秒。

parameters.name: min-rx-interval
parameters.explanation: 最小接收间隔，单位为毫秒。

parameters.name: multiplier
parameters.explanation: 检测乘数，用于计算检测超时时间。

set forwarding-options forwarder bfd tem.template: set forwarding-options forwarder bfd template [parameter1] discriminator local [parameter2] remote [parameter3]
set forwarding-options forwarder bfd tem.command: set forwarding-options forwarder bfd template AToB discriminator local 1 remote 2
set forwarding-options forwarder bfd tem.explanation: 配置BFD模板的本地和远端标识符。
